summary: Implemented platform.sandbox module with DockerSandbox (docker-py adapter with gVisor runtime support), EgressPolicy (configurable allowlist with defaults for LLM APIs, package registries, MCP endpoints), and full test suite (25 tests). DockerSandbox.create() returns running containers with proxy defaults, bind mounts, resource limits, and labels. EgressPolicy blocks arbitrary internet/git remotes and logs allowlist on startup.
concerns: gVisor (runsc) runtime not available in current Docker environment — fallback to plain Docker tested via runtime='' config path. Smoke test needed before committing to runsc.
Integration/E2E tests (pip install through proxy, curl blocked, git commands failing) require running Docker daemon with mitmproxy and are not covered by unit tests.
